description:
Sol QA, P1 trap. pi lifecycle-handlers.ts:359,422,483,523: an undecodable tool_result becomes unknown-write requiring a target, records <unresolved-target>, and recoverPending always skips that key. Every session_stop then blocks before the Python Stop hook, so T-035 never releases it. Sol reproduced 8 identical blocking Stops. Violates the user rule that an agent must never get stuck completely.

Fix: count identical unresolved-target Stop blocks and release after the same limit as an own finding (5), with a visible message listing the unresolved tool calls for the user and a ledger row. A later decodable result for the same call clears it.

Acceptance: 5 Stops block, the 6th releases with the list; a new unresolved target re-arms. Tests (bun) by adw-test-writer, including the recovery path pre-execution-block.test.ts never exercised.
title: Release an OMP unresolved-target Stop block after the stall limit
